summary.text: John Inglis is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 38 who took office on December 1, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former high school civics and psychology teacher who became a school counselor, he has also served on the West Mifflin Borough Council.

paragraphs.text: Inglis earned a bachelor's degree from Duquesne University and a graduate degree from Westminster College, and his career experience includes working as an educator.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he taught civics and psychology for many years at West Mifflin Area High School before becoming a counselor there, and that he was a twice-elected member of the West Mifflin Borough Council.
Inglis defeated Republican Stone Sobieralski in the November 5, 2024 general election for District 38, succeeding Nick Pisciottano.
Sobieralski is again his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
In the same survey, Inglis listed school funding, workers' rights and support for first responders as his key campaign messages.
